usage: bacnet-bbmd-verify [-h] --device-ip DEVICE_IP [--device-prefix DEVICE_PREFIX]
                          [--local-bcast LOCAL_BCAST] [--bbmd BBMD] [--port PORT]
                          [--src-port SRC_PORT] [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--json]

Verify BACnet/IP BBMD + Who-Is/I-Am cross-subnet reachability (read-only).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --device-ip DEVICE_IP
                        a known field device on the OTHER subnet (e.g. 192.168.0.50)
  --device-prefix DEVICE_PREFIX
                        prefix length of the device subnet (default 24)
  --local-bcast LOCAL_BCAST
                        broadcast address of THIS host's interface (default limited broadcast)
  --bbmd BBMD           IP to probe as a BBMD (Read-BDT/Read-FDT)
  --port PORT           BACnet/IP UDP port (default 47808)
  --src-port SRC_PORT   local UDP bind port (use 0 if Niagara holds 47808 on this host)
  --timeout TIMEOUT     per-probe listen window (s)
  --json                machine-readable output
